purpose: Machine-readable navigation and maintenance contract for the public-safe Foundation repository within a two-repository family.

family_governance.rule: Foundation documents may describe its own implementation, but family-wide ownership and dependency rules remain canonical in FAMILY_CONTRACT.json.

family_ownership.foundation: public-safe research contracts, evidence/result primitives, deterministic observed-data core, public Worker boundary, and public CI
family_ownership.operations: private policy, resources, evaluation, promotion, trust boundary, chatbot control-plane knowledge, private execution, deployment, and private validation
family_ownership.extractor-mapper: retired historical source only; selected material is retained under operations/archive/extractor-mapper/

public_package.name: research-intelligence-engine
public_package.pin_rule: Operations consumes an explicit Foundation commit rather than an unpinned moving branch; implementation is never copy-pasted across repositories.

public_worker_boundary.readiness: public Worker runtime plus public D1 health; no private CONTROL_PLANE dependency
public_worker_boundary.public_diagnostic: bounded infrastructure verification only; no arbitrary private service dispatch
public_worker_boundary.private_integration: Operations may call Foundation through its protected Service Binding for authorized private verification
public_worker_boundary.public_secrets: no private credentials or private topology in source

chatbot_boundary.role: accept typed public-safe research requests; do not parse private policy or private extraction implementation

ci_boundary.private_ci: Operations has no GitHub-hosted private Actions dependency
ci_boundary.coverage_rule: 100% branch coverage for Foundation product sources under the public coverage gate
ci_boundary.private_evidence_rule: Foundation CI does not certify private Operations runtime behavior

design_rules: chatbot must use typed contracts rather than duplicate algorithms
evidence selection is budgeted but caller-defined trust policy remains outside Foundation
generated artifacts are never sources of truth
public files use ordinary descriptive names
private functionality is excluded by architecture and boundary scans
public readiness remains independently testable from private control-plane availability
compatibility facades must re-export/adapt only and never become a second algorithm

avoid: lossy evidence compression without explicit budget

change_method: read the canonical family contract and current Operations master/status documents when available
add boundary regression for cross-repo changes
run overlap/ownership audit when structure changes
preserve historical migration evidence in Operations archive when relevant
